title: Bonus Station Cash (Best Buy prepaid card promotion)
names_seen: Bonus Station Cash (Best Buy prepaid card promotion)

facts.statement: A limited promotion gave 500 Station Cash for buying a $15 prepaid card at Best Buy between 17 and 19 August.
facts.quote: Ganhe 500 Station Cash na compra de um cartão pré-pago de $15 na Best Buy entre os dias 17 e 19 de Agosto.

facts.statement: The promotion's redemption window ran from 04:01 on 17/08/12 to 04:01 on 19/08/12.
facts.quote: Resgate entre 17/08/12 apartir das 04:01 até as 04:01 do dia 19/08/12.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Vem Aí: Bonus Station Cash!)
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language freerealms.com news post announcing a limited Station Cash bonus: buying a $15 prepaid card at Best Buy during 17-19 August (2012) grants 500 Station Cash. The page gives redemption window times but no post date, and the surrounding page text is site navigation.
